note: Asset provenance for the Spelltype frontend. Every shipped bitmap under public/assets/ is either a generated source bitmap that the coordinating agent produced with its image-gen tool, a local derivation (split, trim, bleed, resize, re-encode) of such a bitmap, or an explicitly hand-authored SVG labelled "hand-authored" and never described as generated. The image model name is not exposed to this worker, so none is claimed. All processing is local and deterministic and reproducible with scripts/process-art.mjs: sharp/libvips for decode, resize and encode, alpha taken from the masters themselves or derived from luminance for glow art on a dark backdrop, and a sharp-rendered SVG gradient for the portrait backdrops. No external hosting, CDN or remote URL is used. This pass shipped 44 files (40 arena/character/icon/effect assets plus 4 portraits derived from them) out of 10 unique current masters. Superseded generations, deliberately not shipped: white-background icon atlas (was delivered as spell-icons-sheet.png, sha256 d3f63d73…) — superseded by the black-background regeneration spell-icons-black-sheet.png (sha256 97db63de…) because enclosed backdrop could not be told apart from white highlights inside the artwork.
